name: meta_docs_get_page
description: Fetch the FULL text of a Meta developer documentation page (developers.meta.com). Call AFTER meta_docs_search when you need exact wording — Meta SDK API signatures, AndroidManifest entries, Meta Horizon Store policy text, VRC requirements, full code snippets. Pass `doc_path` or `canonical_url` from meta_docs_search results; do NOT invent URLs (the namespace is non-obvious — /documentation/... vs /horizon/documentation/... vs /horizon/llmstxt/...). Accepts short paths (e.g. 'documentation/unity/ts-adb.md') or full https URLs.

url.description: doc_path or canonical_url from meta_docs_search. Accepts short paths ('documentation/unity/ts-adb.md') or full https://developers.meta.com/horizon/... URLs.
